GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (2 Dec 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN-1373)
APO 500
2 December 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 15 June 1946, file AG 000.5 (15 June 46) LS-R, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one IWABUCHI, Tsune, Lt. Col., to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp) at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said IWABUCHI's name. This name appears as the 2nd name on Page No. 3 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
